description:
IN-13 Stage A, commit (c) of three: the per-source metadata record
persists into project.json's new "metadata" section, and the import
path fills it.

MetadataStore (data/metadata/MetadataStore.kt) follows the AudioStore
pattern exactly: same shared project.json, own section keyed by
sourceId (the join with the sources section — the same fingerprint-
derived id the library row uses), atomic .tmp+rename writes,
forward-tolerant parse, per-row tolerance (a bad row is skipped, never
fatal), and a corrupt section loads as empty while the file survives
untouched.

Honesty rules carried into persistence:
- omit-unknown rendering: an UNKNOWN field renders NOTHING, so records
  stay minimal and a pre-IN-13 project.json gains a section, not noise
- an ESTIMATED field always renders its basis "b", and a hand-corrupted
  estimate WITHOUT a basis is refused on read (the row is skipped, the
  guess i
